correctness.rationale: For each long-arm leaf b_i, exactly one of a_i,b_i must be selected. Center selection uniquely forces c and all b_i. Center exclusion forces all t short leaves and one per long arm, requiring nonempty set of a_i precisely if t=0. Comparing the resulting exact cardinalities yields every minimum set. Their pairwise token slides are exactly coordinate flips, with one additional center/short-leaf edge for t=1. Explicit geodesics/Gray paths, median witnesses and one-vertex gluing verify graph geometry. An independent brute-force verifier checks 20 instances with 163680 source subsets and 625 actual slide edges; no finite check is mistaken for proof.
